argon2-cffi.rationale: Redundant with maistro-core's direct argon2-cffi dependency; Conductor has no production argon2 import. #514 owns removing or reconciling the duplicate pin.

bcrypt.rationale: Conductor currently supplies maistro.security.passwords' lazy bcrypt legacy verifier even though maistro-core does not declare that runtime import; #514 owns moving dependency ownership to core or another explicit boundary.

langfuse.rationale: Conductor telemetry imports OpenTelemetry and only targets a Langfuse OTLP endpoint; it never imports the Langfuse SDK. #514 owns replacing or removing this proxy dependency.

python-multipart.rationale: FastAPI Form(...) in backend/routes/design.py causes Starlette to load the multipart parser dynamically; the application itself does not import python-multipart.

regex.rationale: Redundant with maistro-core's hard regex dependency used by Warden; Conductor has no production regex import. #514 owns removing or reconciling the duplicate pin.

structlog.rationale: Conductor has no production structlog import and maistro-core already owns structlog. #514 owns removing or reconciling this duplicate direct pin.

uvicorn.rationale: packages/hive-conductor/backend/Dockerfile invokes the uvicorn console entry point to serve main:app, so runtime use is external to Python imports.

asyncpg.rationale: frontend/server/models/db.py selects the postgresql+asyncpg SQLAlchemy dialect, which loads asyncpg by driver name rather than a source import.

pyyaml.rationale: maistro-design has no production yaml import while maistro-core owns YAML parsing; #514 owns removing or relocating this unimported direct pin.

pydantic.rationale: maistro-rsi does not import pydantic directly; its Pydantic-backed PipelineGenome arrives through maistro-evolve. #514 owns removing or reconciling this duplicate direct pin.

fastmcp.rationale: Server reaches FastMCP through imported maistro-core tool server modules, not a server import; #514 owns expressing this through the appropriate maistro-core extra instead of a raw duplicate pin.

langfuse.rationale: maistro-server has no production langfuse import. #514 owns removing the stale pin or replacing it with the actual observability dependency if a consumer is demonstrated.

uvicorn.rationale: The server image and launcher invoke the uvicorn console entry point to serve maistro_server.main:app; application modules do not import the entrypoint package.

httpx.rationale: maistro-turing has no production httpx import and maistro-core already owns HTTPX; #514 owns removing or reconciling this duplicate direct pin.

structlog.rationale: maistro-turing has no production structlog import and maistro-core already owns structlog; #514 owns removing or reconciling this duplicate direct pin.
